jobs.description:
Pasadena Independent School District in Texas is seeking a Police Officer to safeguard students, staff and property across district campuses. You will enforce federal, state and local laws and respond to incidents with professional judgment.

The role requires physical fitness, operation of emergency equipment, and the ability to work shifts in a school setting, including 240 duty days per year. Experience in law enforcement and a Texas Peace Officer license are preferred.
